summary: First iteration E2E testing complete. All 23 backend pytest cases pass (health, auth, profile, goals catalog, diagnostic flow, LLM plan generation with GPT-5.2, task tracking, knowledge base, dashboard). Frontend flows work end-to-end (landing -> profile -> goals -> diagnostic 6Q -> LLM plan -> task tracking -> dashboard -> planes -> conocimiento). Found one real routing bug: after successful registration, users land on /dashboard instead of /perfil (race between setUser triggering PublicOnly's <Navigate to='/dashboard'> and Register's nav('/perfil')). Same behavior likely for Login.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful register/login, user is redirected to /dashboard instead of the intended /perfil. Root cause: `setUser` triggers re-render of `PublicOnly` on /registro path BEFORE `nav('/perfil')` executes; `<Navigate to='/dashboard' replace />` wins the race and replaces history. Result: first-time users skip the /perfil onboarding step entirely.

action_items: Fix Register.jsx (and Login.jsx if same pattern) so first-time users reach /perfil after registration. Options: (a) inside PublicOnly, redirect to /perfil when the user is fresh (`!user.profile_complete`); (b) call `nav('/perfil', { replace: true })` before `setUser`; (c) have `register()` in auth-context accept a target route and perform navigation after state settles; (d) use `useEffect` in a landing route to redirect based on profile_complete.
Consider gating the requirement in the review request ('After success, user is redirected to /perfil') is currently NOT met.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` (deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers).
backend/server.py imports `time` was never needed; `import json`/`import re` are inside function (fine but could be top-level).
backend/server.py: `_apply_rules` uses `seen.add()` as a side effect inside list comprehension — works but obscure. Prefer explicit loop.

backend `PLAN_TEMPLATES['publicos']` has only 5 tasks and no LLM-suggested extras when overlap detected; a plan may have fewer than 5 action_items if template shrinks. Currently vender_entradas has 5 template tasks + up to 5 AI recs, so ok. Consider enforcing min items.

Frontend: `PublicOnly` -> `<Navigate to='/dashboard'>` unconditionally sends already-authenticated users to dashboard, even freshly registered users who need /perfil. This is the root cause of the redirect bug (see action items).

Frontend: `Diagnostic.jsx` allows submitting empty answers via keyboard (only mouse click validates). Textarea has no `onKeyDown` handler for Enter, but hint says 'enter para continuar' — hint is misleading; Enter inserts newline. Consider Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to submit, or remove the hint.
Frontend: no loading skeleton on Diagnostic while `session` is null — just 'Cargando…'. Minor UX.

Backend `/api/knowledge/documents` returns tags but response endpoints for full doc via `/api/knowledge/documents/{id}` returns the raw KNOWLEDGE_SEED dict (contains all keys). Safe (no _id) but inconsistent shape between list and detail.
test_credentials: Tests register fresh users each run with test_<uuid>@example.com / cultora123. Existing seeded account maria@example.com / cultora123 not required.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests self-provision a new user per session and clean-up not implemented (documents remain in test_database).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend E2E is solid; re-running /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with `pytest -n 0` (serial) is the fastest verification (~14s). For UI, after main agent fixes the register/login redirect, verify: register -> automatic land on /perfil (NOT dashboard) without any manual URL navigation. Also verify same for login of a user whose profile_complete is false. Playwright tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. LLM (gpt-5.2 via Emergent LLM Key) responds in ~10-30s; keep timeouts >= 90s for plan generation.
rca of the issue:
In /app/frontend/src/pages/Register.jsx submit handler:
    await register(name, email, password);   // setUser fires -> auth context updates
    toast.success('Cuenta creada. Empecemos.');
    nav('/perfil');
Because `await` yields control, React can flush the setUser update BEFORE `nav('/perfil')` is called. At that flush, App.js's PublicOnly wrapper (still on /registro because URL hasn't changed yet) re-renders, sees user!=null, and returns <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace />. The Navigate component runs synchronously during render and pushes /dashboard to history with `replace`. Then nav('/perfil') runs, but /perfil is added on top — however testing shows the browser ends up at /dashboard (perhaps the Navigate's replace occurs after the imperative nav). Either way, from the user's perspective, right after Crear cuenta the URL settles on /dashboard, skipping the profile onboarding.
Reproduction: register a fresh account via /registro; final URL is /dashboard. Expected: /perfil.
Mitigation options (pick one, all safe):
  1) Register.jsx: swap order — call `nav('/perfil')` first (via history.replaceState-style) OR do `nav('/perfil', { replace: true })` immediately after register() and BEFORE the promise chain yields.
  2) auth-context: expose `registerAndNavigate(targetPath)` that updates user AND sets a redirect intent, then let a top-level effect perform navigation once user is set.
  3) PublicOnly: instead of always redirecting to /dashboard, redirect to /perfil when `!user.profile_complete`, else /dashboard. This is the smallest and most robust fix.
  4) Use `<Navigate>` from Register.jsx (i.e., render <Navigate to='/perfil'> when register succeeds) so both routings compete as React elements deterministically.
